profile.role_note: Hybrid: sub-DPS, healer, and the game's best Heavy Attack buffer; can also hypercarry.

pull_verdict.verdict: The third pick of Phase 1 for most accounts (sources rank Hsin > Chisa > Iuno): a flexible Aero healer/buffer whose Heavy Attack amplification is still premium for Heavy Attack teams — but a luxury if you already own her or your sustain slots are full.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Moongazer's Sigil (or Verity's Handle) + 3-piece Crown of Valor / 2-piece Sierra Gale in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, Lady of the Sea as the main Echo. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Aero DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and roughly 120% Energy Regen. Level her Forte Circuit first.

ranked_weapons.name: Moongazer's Sigil
ranked_weapons.note: 36% Crit Rate substat. Grants +12% ATK, +20% Resonance Liberation DMG on Intro/Liberation casts, and up to 36% DEF ignore on her Liberation as she generates shields. Best in slot by a wide margin.

ranked_weapons.name: Verity's Handle
ranked_weapons.note: 24.3% Crit Rate substat. Grants +12% All-Attribute DMG and +48% Resonance Liberation DMG for 8s after casting Liberation. The strongest non-signature option.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Justice
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% substat. Grants DEF ignore that applies broadly across her kit. Usable but weaker than Verity's Handle.

ranked_weapons.name: Tragic Comedy
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% substat. Grants +48% Heavy Attack DMG on Basic/Intro casts; helps her Heavy Attack buff loop but not her Liberation ceiling.

ranked_weapons.name: Aether Strike
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate substat with extra ATK% and Liberation DMG on Liberation casts. The recommended 4-star pick.

ranked_weapons.name: Stonard
ranked_weapons.note: nearly identical to Aether Strike: Crit Rate plus Liberation DMG.

ranked_weapons.name: Legend of Drunken Hero
ranked_weapons.note: the best free-to-play option: builds ATK% buffs while hitting debuffed enemies.

ranked_weapons.name: Celestial Spiral
ranked_weapons.note: free-to-play filler: helps Liberation uptime and grants ATK% on Skill casts.

echo_sets.name: Crown of Valor + Sierra Gale
echo_sets.note: Crown of Valor stacks ATK and Crit DMG as the wearer gains shields — Iuno shields herself constantly, so she keeps it fully stacked. Sierra Gale supplies the 2-pc Aero DMG bonus. Lady of the Sea gives Aero DMG Bonus and Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus in the main slot and completes the 3-pc.

echo_sets.name: Gusts of Welkin or Windward Pilgrimage
echo_sets.note: Swap-in for Sierra Gale — any 2-pc Aero DMG set works.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: For a pure-support build: trades personal damage for Energy Regen and a 22.5% ATK buff to the incoming Resonator. Fine early-game option before farming her proper set.

stat_priorities.note: Crit DMG if Crit Rate is healthy from substats and weapon; Crit Rate if it isn't. Aim for roughly 70-80% Crit Rate overall.
Aero DMG Bonus on both by default. One can be ATK% if its substats are clearly better, at a small damage loss.

teams.name: Premium: Augusta + Iuno + Shorekeeper

members.name: Augusta
members.note: Iuno's best teammate across every source. A Heavy Attack carry who generates shields constantly — feeding Iuno's shield-stack damage buff while cashing in the full 50% Heavy Attack amplification from Iuno's Outro.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Hybrid sub-DPS and support. Cycles her Lunar Cycle moon stances, drops her Full Moon Domain (heals and restores stamina), and swaps out with her buff-loaded Outro right before Augusta's damage window.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: The sustain. Heals and hands out Crit and All-DMG buffs through her Stellarealm field while asking for almost no field time.

teams.rotation: Open with Shorekeeper to build Concerto Energy, cast her Liberation, then swap to Iuno. Run Iuno's Lunar Cycle — Skill into New Moon stance, Liberation, basics and skills, then a Heavy Attack to plant the Full Moon Domain — and swap to Augusta the moment her Intro Skill is ready. Burn through Augusta's window, then loop back to Shorekeeper to refresh.

teams.name: Budget: Iuno + Mortefi + Verina

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Takes more field time here as the primary damage dealer and sustain in one: her full Lunar Cycle rotation deals real damage while her Domain keeps everyone healed, and her Outro still feeds Heavy Attack amplification to the team.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: The 4-star Heavy Attack battery. His Outro buffs Heavy Attack damage and his coordinated attacks keep chipping in while he's benched — the cheapest Heavy Attack support in the game.

members.name: Verina
members.note: The free sustain: healing, ATK buffs, and general team support with minimal investment.

teams.rotation: Open with Verina for buffs and her Liberation, swap to Mortefi to build Concerto and fire his Outro, then bring Iuno in for an extended Lunar Cycle rotation — Skill, Liberation, basics, Heavy Attack for the Domain — before looping back. Every piece is free or 4-star and the buff layering works the same way.

teams.name: Alternative: Hypercarry Iuno + Lynae + Mornye

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Stays on-field as the carry instead of supporting one. Runs her full extended Lunar Cycle rotation — Intro, Skill, Liberation, basics and enhanced skills — dealing the team's damage herself while her Domain covers sustain.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: The buffer. Her Liberation grants team-wide All-DMG, her Outro amplifies the next character's damage and Liberation bursts, and she feeds Iuno's big windows.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Holds the sustain slot: healing plus team-wide damage buffs so Iuno never has to leave the field to survive.

teams.rotation: Lynae first for her Liberation and Outro buffs, a quick Mornye stop for heals and buffs, then Iuno for a long on-field Lunar Cycle stretch. Swap out only to refresh Lynae's buffs when they expire. Community testing rates it as a genuinely viable main-DPS comp.

tier_badge.label: Meta-defining
tier_badge.note: Top-tier Heavy Attack buffer and healer; core of the best Fusion and Aero teams.
